_comment: PROPOSAL ONLY - not applied. Activation checklist issue #431 items 1-4 pre-staged; items 5-7 remain deliberate decisions. Apply by merging the 'delta' block into .devin/laya/profile.json only after review.

checkpoint.vendoring_note: HF cache path is fragile (cache clean = model_path_missing). Before activation, copy the snapshot to a stable path (e.g. .devin/laya/models/english/) preserving relative layout - _artifact_sha256 is content+relpath based so the digest is unchanged by the move.

calibration.data_source: maintainer-authored frozen manifests, real worker captures

activation_semantics.mode_transition: off -> shadow -> assist (reviewed, tested each step)
activation_semantics.adoptable_requires: request.mode == 'assist' AND calibrated_p >= threshold AND effective_mode == 'assist'
activation_semantics.per_consumer_optin: intent.suggest(mode=...) is a per-call parameter defaulting to 'shadow' - only consumers explicitly requesting assist can adopt; other profiles stay suggestion-only even under global mode=assist
activation_semantics.calibration_is_global: single calibration block applies to every request that reaches adoptable; binding to media-intent-v1 relies on per-consumer mode opt-in, not per-profile gating

open_decisions: item5 residual-risk: complaint->stylize_video mitigation (consumer-side imperative-only guard vs non-saturating table map) - trade-off documented in media-intent-v1 README; guard NOT shipped
item6 deliberate mode transition with review
item7 re-run held-out batch after any map/state change (warm_engine now absorbs cold-start deadline misses)
known_corrections_since_issue_filed: deadline_exceeded misses were cold-start artifact - fixed by laya_worker.warm_engine (b69c878); coverage in existing manifests understated by ~1 case each
skill-pick engine_error:TypeError root-caused to cp1252 stdio mojibake - fixed by pin_stdio_utf8, not transient
